# Tensions Reference

Complete reference for the `glassfrog tension` command group — capturing,
reading, editing, discarding, and rolling up tensions.

## Overview

A tension is a sensed gap or opportunity in governance, recorded against a role
and used as the seed (`tension_id`) of a proposal. `glassfrog tension` is a
non-runnable command group; running it with no subcommand prints help. Each verb
maps to exactly one API endpoint:

| Command | API operation | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `tension create <role-id>` | `POST /roles/{role_id}/tensions` | Capture a new tension sensed by a role |
| `tension list <role-id>` | `GET /roles/{role_id}/tensions` | List a role's own tensions |
| `tension get <ten-id>` | `GET /tensions/{id}` | Read one tension by id |
| `tension update <ten-id>` | `PATCH /tensions/{id}` | Edit a tension's fields |
| `tension discard <ten-id>` | `DELETE /tensions/{id}` | Soft-delete a tension |
| `tension subroles <role-id>` | `GET /roles/{role_id}/subroles/tensions` | Roll up tensions across direct sub-roles |

None of the tension commands is Premium-gated. The sensing person (`sensed_by`)
is always derived from the token's identity — you never name yourself.

Codebase enrichment skipped — not attempted. This reference is based on the
interface contracts only.

## Vocabularies

| Field | Values | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| status | `unprocessed`, `processed`, `archived` | Server-owned. Auto-computed on capture; `archived` is set explicitly via `update`. On reads, `--status` is a filter only. |
| meeting-type | `tactical`, `governance` | A routing-intent hint, not a meeting binding. |

## `glassfrog tension create` — capture a tension

### Synopsis

```
glassfrog tension create <ROLE_ID> --body "<text>" [--label "<text>"]
                         [--meeting-type tactical|governance] [--base-url URL] [-o FORMAT]
```

Produces the created tension, including its `ten_` id, body, status, and sensing
role/person.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ROLE_ID` | string | yes | The sensing role (`role_…`). Exactly one required; zero or more than one is a usage error with no API call. Not validated locally — an unknown id returns `404`. |

| Flag | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--body` | string | yes | The tension's body. An omitted, empty, or whitespace-only body is a usage error before any request — a bodyless tension is meaningless. |
| `--label` | string | no | A short title sent alongside the body. |
| `--meeting-type` | string | no | Routing hint, validated against `tactical`/`governance` before any request; an unsupported value is a usage error. |

`create` exposes no `--status` flag (the server auto-computes status) and no
proposer flag (the server derives `sensed_by` from the token).

## `glassfrog tension list` — list a role's tensions

### Synopsis

```
glassfrog tension list <ROLE_ID> [--status STATUS] [--first-page] [--per-page N]
                       [--base-url URL] [-o FORMAT]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ROLE_ID` | string | yes | The role whose own tensions to list (`role_…`). Exactly one required. |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--status` | string | — | Filter by status, sent as `status`. Validated locally against `unprocessed`/`processed`/`archived`; an unsupported value is a usage error with no API call. |
| `--first-page` | bool | false | Fetch only the first page; signal on stderr if more exist. |
| `--per-page` | int | API max (500) | Page size for the walk. |

Walks every page to completion by default. An empty result (the role has no
tensions, or none match the status) exits successfully — an empty list is a valid
answer. See [Completeness](#completeness) below.

## `glassfrog tension get` — read one tension

### Synopsis

```
glassfrog tension get <TEN_ID> [--base-url URL] [-o FORMAT]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `TEN_ID` | string | yes | The tension to read (`ten_…`). Exactly one required. Passed through unvalidated; an unknown id returns `404`. |

`get` declares no `--status` flag — passing it is a usage error. The read is
unpaginated.

## `glassfrog tension update` — edit a tension

### Synopsis

```
glassfrog tension update <TEN_ID> [--body "<text>"] [--label "<text>"]
                         [--status STATUS] [--meeting-type tactical|governance]
                         [--base-url URL] [-o FORMAT]
```

Applies a partial update — only the supplied fields are sent; every unsupplied
field is left untouched. At least one field flag is required; an update with no
field flags is a usage error with no API call.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `TEN_ID` | string | yes | The tension to edit (`ten_…`). Exactly one required. |

| Flag | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--body` | string | New body. An empty or whitespace-only value is a usage error — a tension cannot be blanked out. |
| `--label` | string | New label. |
| `--status` | string | New status, validated against `unprocessed`/`processed`/`archived`. Unlike `create`, status is editable here — the server allows the transition (notably to `archived`) on a `PATCH`. |
| `--meeting-type` | string | New routing hint, validated against `tactical`/`governance`. |

`update` offers no way to clear a field to empty/null, sends no `If-Match`
concurrency guard (last-write-wins), and does not re-target the sensing role or
person.

## `glassfrog tension discard` — soft-delete a tension

### Synopsis

```
glassfrog tension discard <TEN_ID> [--base-url URL] [-o FORMAT]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `TEN_ID` | string | yes | The tension to discard (`ten_…`). Exactly one required. |

**Flags**: none beyond the inherited root flags — discard removes a tension whole.

The endpoint is a **soft-delete** (it sets `discarded_at`; it does not erase) and
leaves the tension's proposals in place. A successful delete returns `204` with no
body, so the command synthesizes a structured result carrying the discarded
`ten_` id and a discarded marker.

**`404` is treated as success.** The delete is not REST-strict idempotent: a
re-run of an already-discarded tension returns `404`, which is the same end-state
(the tension is gone), so the command exits zero. It writes an advisory note to
stderr stating which happened — discarded a live tension (`204`) or found it
already gone (`404`). The accepted cost is that discarding a mistyped id reports
success. There is no confirmation prompt and no restore operation.

## `glassfrog tension subroles` — roll up sub-role tensions

### Synopsis

```
glassfrog tension subroles <ROLE_ID> [--status STATUS] [--first-page] [--per-page N]
                           [--base-url URL] [-o FORMAT]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ROLE_ID` | string | yes | The anchor role whose **direct** sub-roles' tensions to roll up (`role_…`). Exactly one required. Must be an expanded role (a circle, `has_subroles: true`); a leaf role returns `404`. |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--status` | string | — | Filter by status, validated as for `list`. |
| `--first-page` | bool | false | Fetch only the first page. |
| `--per-page` | int | API max (500) | Page size for the walk. |

The roll-up is **one level only** — the anchor's direct children, not the whole
subtree — and it does not include the anchor role's own tensions (that is `tension
list`). A leaf-role `404` is surfaced as a plain read failure, not reinterpreted
as an empty list.

## Completeness

The paginated commands (`list`, `subroles`) never silently truncate:

- **Default** — walk every page and render the complete set.
- **`--first-page`** — one page; if more exist, a "more exist" note on stderr,
  exit `0`.
- **Mid-walk failure** — the tensions gathered so far, flagged incomplete with the
  cause on stderr, exit non-zero.

## Inherited flags

| Flag | Owner | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--base-url` | 011 | Override the API base URL. |
| `-o`, `--output` | 020/035 | `full` (default) \| `compact` \| `json` \| `yaml` \| a user-template ref. |

Successful output is rendered by Output Format Selection in the resolved format;
`json`/`yaml` emit the structured document verbatim, `full`/`compact` render the
human projection. No command defines its own format flag.

## Error reference

Failure rendering is format-aware: `json`/`yaml` write the unified error envelope
to stdout; `full`/`compact` write the diagnostic (cause + next step) to stderr.
Every diagnostic names the cause and a next step and never includes the token. No
tension command introduces its own exit code.

| Condition | Outcome | Exit |
|---|---|---|
| Success (incl. empty list; discard `204`/`404`) | Success | 0 |
| Missing/extra positional, missing/blank `--body`, no field flags on `update`, unsupported `--status`/`--meeting-type`, `--status` on `get`, unknown flag, invalid `--output`, base-URL config error, no usable token | UsageError | 2 |
| Unreadable/malformed credential file, render failure | RuntimeError | 1 |
| Unknown role/tension id (`404`, except discard), rejected field (`422`), leaf-role anchor on `subroles` (`404`), other `4xx`/`5xx`, response shape mismatch | APIError | 3 |
| Permission (`401`/`403`) | PermissionError | 4 |
| Rate limited (`429`) — writes are not auto-retried | RateLimited | 5 |
| Could not reach the wire | NetworkUnavailable | 6 |
